verdict.rationale: DBOS's core library is explicitly described as open-source and hosted on GitHub (dbos-gh-1, dbos-docs-2, dbos-docs-20), so its source is readable/inspectable. However, no specific license name (e.g., MIT/Apache) is cited anywhere, and community evidence notes that key management/observability components (Conductor, web UI) are NOT open-source (dbos-comm-11, dbos-comm-8), limiting how much of the full product's source is actually open. Missing for 10: explicit license identification, and openness of the Conductor/console components.
